changes: Added five new views: Timeline (chronological, grouped by year), Capital Flows (which financial investors — CPP Investments, Blackstone, TPG, IFC, Alpha Wave Global, Carlyle, Anchorage Capital — are backing which operators), and Policy & Incentives (national/state programs tracked separately from physical facilities).
Added a Sustainability layer: land footprint, power source, and cooling technology where disclosed, surfaced in the detail panel and as a sidebar filter.
Added a Data & API panel with full-dataset JSON/CSV downloads and a raw-JSON endpoint for anyone who wants to build on this data directly, plus a per-view CSV export from the table.
Full visual redesign: new navigation, Inter typeface, refined spacing, hover/focus states, and smoother transitions throughout.

Flagged five facilities with conflicting figures across sources (Google's Visakhapatnam investment, AWS's overlapping commitment numbers, Adani's shifting capacity targets, STT GDC's phase sizing, Ola Krutrim's GPU generation naming) with an on-page warning badge instead of silently picking one number.
Added SEO metadata: page title, meta description, Open Graph and Twitter Card tags, canonical URL, and JSON-LD structured data.
Prepped for repository slug rename to india-ai-datacenter-tracker for a more searchable URL.
Initial launch: 48 facilities and programs tracked across 33 operators and 11 states/UTs, compiled from public announcements, press releases, and news coverage.
Interactive map (Leaflet, clustered, sized by MW capacity, color-coded by status) plus a sortable table view, filters, search, and a per-facility detail panel with linked sources.
Published to GitHub Pages with an automated validate-and-deploy pipeline.
